PrivacyConsent.label: Privacy notice
PrivacyConsent.body: We use cookies to keep you signed in and remember your language, and Sentry to report errors. These are needed to run ANTEI. Optional session replay records how you use the app, with all text masked, to help us find the cause of problems.

welcome.title: Welcome to ANTEI
welcome.description: Start for free with 5 generations a day and no API key. Add your own keys later to access all models and use your providers' quotas instead of the daily free limit.

model.title: Choose a model
model.description: Models marked Free work without an API key, up to 5 times a day. Add your own key to access all models.

samplePrompt.title: Sample prompt ready
samplePrompt.description: We've pre-filled a sample prompt for you — hit Generate to try it out!

apiKey.title: Want to use your own API key?
apiKey.description: You can add your own provider keys for unlimited generation. Skip this if you want to use the default workspace keys.

generate.title: Generate!
generate.description: Hit this button when you're ready. Your image will be auto-archived with its prompt and model info.

webImageImport.unreachable: The site hosting that image refused the download. Try another candidate.
webImageImport.unsupported: That link is not a supported image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF).
webImageImport.tooLarge: That image is too large to import.
webImageImport.noImageOnPage: That is a web page and it declares no main image. Send the address of the picture itself (right-click it, Copy image address).
webImageImport.forbidden: The site hosting this image refused our download (hotlink protection or anti-bot). Try another candidate.
webImageImport.notFound: That image address is gone (the original site removed or moved it). Try another candidate.
webImageImport.rateLimited: That site is rate-limiting us right now. Wait a moment, then press "use this" again.
webImageImport.serverError: The site hosting this image returned an error of its own. Retry later, or pick another.
webImageImport.timeout: Fetching that image timed out. Retry later, or pick a smaller one.

assistant.audioUnsupported: This model cannot analyze audio. Select Gemini or remove the audio attachment.
assistant.videoUnsupported: This model cannot analyze video. Choose Gemini or remove the video reference.
assistant.imageUnsupported: This model cannot analyze images. Choose a model labeled for image vision, or remove the image reference.
assistant.modelKeyMissing: The assistant model you picked has no key for its provider, so nothing ran — no other provider was used in its place. Add the key, or pick another model.
assistant.modelCannotSee: The assistant model can't look at pictures, so this was not sent — no other provider was used in its place. To use it, pick a model that can see pictures in the assistant's model menu.
assistant.contentBlocked: The provider blocked this request under its safety policy. Rephrase, or switch the assistant route.
assistant.outputTruncated: The model reached its response limit before finishing. Try again or start a shorter conversation.
assistant.noTextResponse: The model returned an empty answer. Retry, or switch the assistant route.
assistant.phantomCitation: The assistant cited a source that couldn't be verified, so the answer isn't shown. Try again, or turn off web research for this reply.
assistant.videoUnreachable: This video could not be fetched (it may be deleted, private, or blocked from external access). Try a public link, or download the clip and drop it in.
assistant.timelinePlanFailed: Couldn't create a usable timeline. Try again or describe the sequence you'd like.
assistant.timelinePlanEmpty: There is no finished video card to arrange yet — generate or upload one first.

provider.failed: AI provider error. Please try again.
provider.insufficientBalance: The selected Agent Key has insufficient provider balance. Recharge it or choose another Agent Key.
provider.invalidStructuredOutput: The selected planner model returned an incomplete response. Retry or choose another Agent Key.
provider.invalidApiKey: The selected Agent Key is invalid or no longer authorized. Reconfigure it or choose another Agent Key.
provider.rateLimited: The selected planner route is rate limited. Wait a moment or choose another Agent Key.
provider.safetyBlocked: The provider refused this content due to its safety policy. Try switching to another model (e.g. Gemini if you were on GPT, or vice versa).
provider.temporarilyUnavailable: The selected planner model is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment or choose another Agent Key.
provider.timeout: AI provider timed out. Please try again.
provider.unsupportedOpenAiReferenceImage: OpenAI accepts JPEG, PNG, or WebP reference images. Convert the image and try again.
provider.unsupportedGeminiReferenceImage: Gemini accepts PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, or HEIF reference images. Convert the image and try again.
provider.unsupportedFalReferenceImage: fal.ai could not read this reference image. Use PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF, and make sure the image URL is directly accessible.
provider.unsupportedVolcengineReferenceImage: Seedream could not read this reference image. Use a common format such as JPEG, PNG, or WebP, and make sure the URL is directly accessible.
provider.unsupportedReferenceImage: This model could not read the reference image format. Use JPEG, PNG, or WebP, then try again.
provider.referenceImageTooLarge: The reference image is too large for this model. Compress it or use a smaller image, then try again.
provider.requestTooLarge: The combined size of the text and attachments exceeds this model's request limit. Remove some attachments, use smaller files, or shorten the text.
provider.executionWorkerUnavailable: The generation service cannot be reached right now. Try again later; contact the administrator if it keeps failing.
provider.referenceImageUnreachable: The provider could not download the reference image. Use a direct public image URL or upload the image again.
provider.referenceImageLimitExceeded: This model received too many reference images. Remove some reference images and try again.
provider.transparentBackgroundRequiresSingleRefer: Transparent background needs exactly one reference image with an alpha channel (PNG). Attach a single transparent PNG, or turn the background chip back to opaque.
provider.layerDecompositionRequiresSingleReferenc: Layer split takes exactly one reference image to take apart. Attach a single image, or turn the layer chip off.
provider.promptTooLong: The prompt sent to this model is longer than it accepts. Shorten the prompt (in card mode, including the card text) and try again.
provider.invalidReferenceImageDimensions: The reference image size or aspect ratio is not supported. Use a different image size and try again.
provider.accountLimitReached: The provider account has hit the usage limit configured for this model, and the model service is paused. Retrying will not help — raise or remove that limit in the provider's console, or switch to a different model.
provider.outputBudgetExhausted: This reasoning model used up its output budget before writing a reply. Retry, switch to a non-reasoning model (e.g. Gemini or DeepSeek), or shorten the prompt.
provider.contextLimitExceeded: This conversation is still too long for the model, even after shortening older messages. Start a new conversation or remove large references.
provider.refused: The selected model declined this request under its content policy. Rephrase the request or choose another Agent Key.
provider.noOutput: The provider completed the request but did not return usable media. Adjust the prompt or try another model.
provider.callbackTimeout: The result has not arrived yet. Check your generation history before deciding whether to retry.
provider.storageUploadFailed: The provider returned media, but saving it failed. Try again.
provider.loraIncompatibleHosted: This LoRA's layer format isn't supported by the hosted model. Try an ANTEI Runner model (faithful recipe clone) instead, if available.
provider.runnerMonthlyLimitExceeded: ANTEI Runner's monthly generation limit has been reached. Try again next month, or use a hosted model instead.
provider.runnerLoraUnavailable: This LoRA is not available on the current generation service. Choose another LoRA or a model that supports it.
provider.loraDownloadDisabled: The creator has disabled downloads for this LoRA on Civitai, so it can't be loaded here. Choose another LoRA.

generation.provider_timeout: Generation took too long. Try again later or choose another model.
generation.provider_rate_limit: Too many requests, please wait a moment
generation.provider_overloaded: This model is at capacity right now. Try another model.
generation.invalid_api_key: The provider API key is invalid or expired. Update it in Settings and try again.
generation.content_filtered: The provider declined this content. Review your prompt and references against its content policy before submitting again.
generation.model_unavailable: This model is temporarily unavailable. Try again later or choose another model.
generation.provider_no_output: The provider did not return usable media
generation.callback_timeout: The result has not arrived yet. Check your generation history before deciding whether to retry.
generation.provider_insufficient_balance: The provider account has insufficient balance
generation.unsupported_reference_image_format: This model cannot read the reference image format
generation.reference_image_too_large: The reference image is too large for this model
generation.reference_image_unreachable: The provider could not download the reference image
generation.reference_image_limit_exceeded: This model received too many reference images
generation.transparent_background_requires_single_r: Transparent background needs exactly one reference image with an alpha channel (PNG).
generation.layer_decomposition_requires_single_refe: Layer split needs exactly one reference image to take apart.
generation.novelai_anlas_shortfall: Your NovelAI account is short on Anlas: this image needs {required}, {available} left. Only an Opus subscription generates for free (one image · ≤1024² · ≤28 steps) — check your subscription or top up Anlas on NovelAI; retrying won't help.
generation.prompt_too_long: The prompt is longer than this model accepts.
generation.invalid_reference_image_dimensions: The reference image size or aspect ratio is not supported
generation.provider_account_limit_reached: The provider account hit its configured usage limit for this model and the service is paused. Retrying will not help — adjust the limit in the provider's console.
generation.provider_model_not_activated: Your provider account has not activated this model yet. Activate it in the provider console (e.g. the Ark / BytePlus model activation page) and try again — retrying as is will not help.
generation.provider_server_error: The provider’s server returned an error (500). This isn’t a problem with your settings — it’s usually a temporary fault on their side. Try again shortly, or switch models.
generation.runner_queue_stuck: This generation was canceled because it could not start. Choose another available model or try again later.
generation.runner_download_mismatch: The downloaded model file doesn't match the checksum its source publishes, so nothing was generated. Retrying downloads it again; if it keeps failing, pick another LoRA or base model.
generation.runner_storage_full: The Runner's model storage is full, so nothing was generated. Try again later; if it keeps failing, ask the administrator to add storage.
generation.execution_worker_unavailable: The generation service cannot be reached right now. Try again later; contact the administrator if it keeps failing.
generation.lora_incompatible_hosted: This model does not support this LoRA format. Choose a compatible model or another LoRA.
generation.runner_monthly_limit_exceeded: This month's Runner generation quota is used up. Switch to a hosted model for now, or wait for next month's reset.
generation.runner_lora_unavailable: This LoRA is not available on the current generation service. Choose another LoRA or a model that supports it.
generation.lora_download_disabled: The creator has disabled downloads for this LoRA. It can only be used in Civitai's generator. Choose another LoRA to use here.
generation.publish_blocked: This work can't be made public: its prompt contains both minor-related and sexual terms. It stays in your library.
generation.publish_blocked_search: This image used Google Search while it was made, so under Google's terms only you can see it — it can't be published.
generation.unknown: Generation failed for an undetermined reason. Try again later. If it keeps failing, share the error details with the administrator.
generation.unknownWithDetail: This generation failed. The provider said: {detail}

validation.invalidInput: Invalid input. Please check your parameters.
validation.invalidJson: The request body could not be read.

Errors.rateLimit: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
Errors.runawayGeneration: Generation was paused because this account sent many repeated requests in a short time. This may be caused by an automatic retry loop. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
Errors.platformGenerationDisabled: Platform-funded generation is turned off. Use a model with your own API key, or ask the site admin to enable it.

profile.bannerTooLarge: Cover image must be under 10 MB.

upload.storageUnreachable: Couldn't upload the image. Check your connection and try again. If it still fails, contact the administrator.
upload.storageRejected: Image storage rejected the upload. Please retry; if it persists, contact the administrator.

scriptDoc.promptTooLong: The script plus this message is too long to revise in one request. Shorten the message or the shot summaries, or split it into fewer shots.

vision.invalidOutput: Couldn't read the analysis results. Try another image or try again later.
vision.insufficientMedia: Comparing needs at least two images.
vision.framesInvalid: The extracted frames didn't match the selected points. Try extracting them again.
